John Danaher - collection 480p/Go Furthe.overview: John Danaher's gi half guard passing and dynamic pinning, eight volumes. Volumes 1 to 5 cover half guard passing using his '4-6-3' system: the skills of controlling the head and shoulders (crossface and underhook), upper body configurations, configuring your free leg, and passing half butterfly guard. Volumes 6 to 8 cover dynamic pinning: the theory, then the three skills (maintaining a single pin, transitioning between pins such as rear to side, and so on).
John Danaher - collection 480p/Go Furthe.for: Gi players who pass to half guard and lose the position after passing.

John Danaher - collection 480p/Go Furthe.overview: John Danaher's gi strangles and turtle breakdowns, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers his '3x3' approach to gi strangles and the details of the strangle hand (three-finger grip, thumb role, short and long leg strangles). Volume 2 is the sliding collar strangle system from the back, including strangling without hooks and the clock strangle. Volume 3 covers cross collar strangles (juji jime) from bottom and mount, with troubleshooting. Volume 4 covers kata juji jime, spinning and sprawling juji jime and the low lapel version. Volume 5 covers the Ezekiel (sode guruma) from the back and front, and the order of operations for rear strangles. Volumes 6 to 8 cover turtle breakdowns: the main turtle variations, targets (hips, head, wrists), breaking the opponent to a hip, the clock theory, and methods when you can't break them down (2-on-1, reverse tight waist, seatbelt roll, back crucifix, kimura).
John Danaher - collection 480p/Go Furthe.for: Gi players who want reliable collar chokes and to attack the turtle.
key: Cross collar (juji jime) from guard and mount

John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.overview: John Danaher's no-gi submission escapes, eight volumes. Volumes 1 to 3 cover the guillotine (escaping it, defending in closed guard, head slipping, standing guillotine defence and ude gaeshi). Volume 4 covers armbar defence. Volume 5 covers triangle defence. Volume 6 covers kimura defence. Volume 7 covers heel hook defence and 'the law of mutual exposure'. Volume 8 covers cross ashi garami defence and inside foot position.
John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.for: No-gi grapplers who want reliable escapes from the main submissions.
key: Heel hook and cross ashi defence

John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.overview: John Danaher's no-gi half guard built on three directions of attack, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers key insights into New Wave guard play. Volume 2 covers making half guard work for you, starting with the knee shield. Volume 3 covers the tight waist series. Volume 4 covers the tight waist versus whizzer battle. Volume 5 covers the knee lever series. Volume 6 covers the elbow escape series. Volume 7 covers knee shield half guard entries (including the scoop elevator). Volume 8 covers deep half guard into leg locks (inside sankaku).
key: Tight waist series and whizzer battles
